digest: MDN explicitly advises removing application-added abort listeners from the combined signal when the operation finishes; claim verified.
verdictDigest: MDN directly supports the lifecycle cleanup advice for listeners added to AbortSignal.any()'s combined signal. Source: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AbortSignal/any_static

evidence.quote: If your code adds `abort` listeners to the combined signal, remove them when the operation finishes, just as you would for any other `AbortSignal`.
evidence.relevance: Directly states the recommended cleanup action.

caveats: This applies to abort listeners added by application code; it is a lifecycle and garbage-collection consideration, not a requirement to cancel the input signals.
